g.text: Two-event role binding across the six fixed conditions
Five paired training realizations per family; every point is shown. Solid lines connect saved means.
Analytic lines are untrained input-only marginal expectations, not fitted neural baselines. No uncertainty intervals are drawn here.
Seeds vary initialization and input/firing streams. Conditions share 256 bags and correlated query pairs; they are not independent replications.
